verses.text: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

segments.text: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh

notes: 127.1 that…: Heb. that are builders of it in it

verses.text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

segments.text: vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows:
so he giveth his beloved sleep.

verses.text: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

segments.text: in the hand of a mighty man; so

verses.text: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

segments.text: the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

notes: 127.5 his…: Heb. filled his quiver with them

headings.text: A Song of degrees for Solomon.
